title: JFK's planned US–Soviet alliance against the Nordics
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of JFK's planned US–Soviet alliance against the Nordics, about 1960s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Was an alliance with the Soviet Union where we would both go to the moon together and if necessary, we would both defend the freedom and independence of humanity

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani told podcast host Jesse Michels that President John F. Kennedy planned an alliance with the Soviet Union in the 1960s. He says the two countries would go to the moon together and, if needed, jointly defend humanity's freedom against the so-called Nordics, tall human-looking beings described in UFO stories. If true, it would mean the Cold War rivals were quietly ready to unite against a non-human threat.
